summary: This standards-track document defines CBOR Web Token, a compact way to represent claims transferred between two parties. The claims are encoded in CBOR and protected with COSE for application-layer security. It is like JWT, but suited to constrained environments.

eli5.summary: A small, signed note that says things about you, like a mini ID card. It is written compactly so little gadgets can carry it.
